swapId.description: QuickSwap bound to the request's idempotency key, as a decimal string: the original QuickSwap on IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, the QuickSwap whose deposit address could not be allocated yet on ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE, or the QuickSwap that never gets one on ADDRESS_CONFLICT.

title.description: Short summary: the HTTP status text.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type: https://polyester.dev/problems/ followed by code in lowercase, with hyphens for underscores, for example https://polyester.dev/problems/rate-limit-exceeded for RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

affiliates.description: Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault: at most three distinct vaults. Fixed at creation with broker_bps.

accountId.description: Public sub-account ID of an active affiliate vault of the broker (QuickSwapBrokerService.CreateAffiliateVault). Create the vault first: an unknown, disabled or other broker's vault, or the default vault, fails with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN.

bps.description: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

brokerBps.description: Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none. broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300. Fees outside these rules fail with FEES_INVALID.

destinationAddress.description: Recipient of the swap output on the destination network, in its native text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes.

destinationMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for destination_address. Required when the destination network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

idempotencyKey.description: Broker-chosen idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'. Scoped to the authenticated broker and retained permanently. The same key with the same request returns the same QuickSwap and deposit address; with a different request it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Requests are compared after every valid address and memo is put in its network's canonical form, so the same address in another case or encoding is the same request; affiliate order is ignored; every other field, the fees included, must be equal.

refundAddress.description: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset on the refund route's network, in its native text form without memo. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

refundMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for refund_address. Required when the refund network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

refundZippedAssetId.description: Refund route for the intermediate asset of a two-leg route: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id of the asset whose AssetConfig.ledger_id is the quote's intermediate_asset_id in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config, for example USDT on Ethereum. Required with refund_address when the route has an intermediate asset; optional and unused otherwise.

returnAddress.description: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network, in its native text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes. Deposits that are not accepted, and source funds that are not traded, go here; never to an observed sender.

returnMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for return_address. Required when the source network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

sourceWallet.description: Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, for brokers that know it in advance. It must be a valid address on the source network, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, and is shown on the QuickSwap.

amount.description: Positive amount in the token units of the route selected by basis: source route for SOURCE_AMOUNT, destination route for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

baseUnits.description: Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. basis.description: Side of the swap that amount denominates.

destinationZippedAssetId.description: Destination asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user receives this asset on this network.

execution.description: Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only; TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

durationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when the QuickSwap is created.

sliceIntervalMs.description: Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded up.

protection.description: Worst execution the end user accepts.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's min_amount_out and min_rate.

minAmountOut.description: Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the quote's min_rate.

address.description: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

addressRetiresAt.description: After this time the deposit address is retired and funds sent to it may not be recoverable. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at. After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before funding_expires_at.

addressState.description: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fundingExpiresAt.description: End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time never executes. A deposit observed on a retired address is MANUAL_RECOVERY and is not returned automatically; other late deposits are RETURN_ONLY. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well before this time. Never changes.

issuedAt.description: When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

memo.description: Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

minNativeGasLimit.description: Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for native-coin deposits on EVM networks: 250000. Polyester does not enforce this limit. On some networks, depositing to an address that has never received funds requires far more than 21000 gas. If the limit is too low, the transaction fails on chain without depositing funds, and the network fee is still charged. Use at least the recommended limit. Unused gas is not charged. Zero for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

reason.description: Why the disposition is RETURN_ONLY, ON_HOLD or MANUAL_RECOVERY; REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise, and for a deposit ON_HOLD for review without a more specific reason.

minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the way to the destination asset, the destination output before the withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

reason.description: Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

minDepositAmount.description: Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. A smaller deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). It is never below the source network's minimum (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config), and differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum.

minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the way to the destination asset, the destination output before the withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

reason.description: Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE: The address accepts the first eligible deposit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND_MODE: Entered on the first confirmed deposit. Any further deposit is returned or held and never executes. Ends at address_retires_at. An address that expires unfunded goes from ACTIVE straight to RETIRED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETIRED: The address is retired. A deposit sent to it is not processed automatically; it is handled only through support-assisted recovery, and recovery is not guaranteed.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ELIGIBLE: The eligible deposit that confirmed first. It consumed the QuickSwap and is the only deposit that can execute.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EVALUATING: Detected; eligibility is being evaluated. A deposit can already be credited (credited_at) while it is evaluated.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANUAL_RECOVERY: Observed on an address that was already retired (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED). It never executes and is not returned automatically. It is handled only through support-assisted recovery, and it is potentially unrecoverable. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ON_HOLD: Held for review; it neither executes nor returns until released. A deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) keeps this disposition after Zipper's compliance team transferred its funds out (QuickSwap CLOSED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN_ONLY: Not accepted: it is returned to return_address and never executes. A deposit found ineligible after it was credited, such as a late deposit (LATE_DEPOSIT), one below min_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) or above max_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM), or one of the wrong asset or network (WRONG_ASSET), keeps credited_at and is returned from its credit.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNTING_INCONSISTENCY: Recorded slice data is inconsistent; no slice amounts are fabricated.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRECISION_UNAVAILABLE: The precision of one or more execution assets is unavailable, so slice amounts cannot be shown accurately. Aggregate amounts may be unknown.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ABOVE_MAXIMUM: The amount exceeded the market's maximum order size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BELOW_MINIMUM: The amount was below the market's minimum order size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEADLINE_REACHED: The execution deadline ended this slice.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTION_ENDED: The execution ended before this slot was used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: Available liquidity did not fill the whole order at its protected price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROTECTION_NOT_MET: No order could satisfy the swap's price protection.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SLOT_MISSED: The slot ended before an order could be sent.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTING: An order has been sent and the outcome is not final.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: No input traded because an order or its execution failed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTLY_TRADED: The slice traded some input but left an order partly unfilled or intermediate funds unconverted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PLANNED: Scheduled; no order has been sent yet.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: No input traded because the slot was not used or no order could fill.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADED: The slice traded its planned orders in full.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AFFILIATE: Affiliate fee of one trading leg, one affiliate's bps of what the leg receives, credited to that affiliate vault. Each affiliate has one per leg; on a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BROKER: Broker fee of one trading leg, the request's broker_bps of what the leg receives, credited to the broker's default vault. A two-leg route has one per leg; a bridge has one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_NETWORK: Network fee withheld from the deposit before it is credited. A quote shows an estimate; the fee withheld is the network's fee when the deposit arrives.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFERRAL: Referral commission of one trading leg: the referral partner's commission_bps (ReferralPricing) of what the leg receives, credited to the partner. It comes out of the broker fee and adds nothing to what the end user pays. Only a request with a referral_code has one; it never appears with AFFILIATE fees. On a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SERVICE: Service fee of one trading leg, credited to Polyester, in basis points of what the leg receives: the leg's pair fee, capped by any fee ceiling agreed with the broker. A two-leg route has one per leg. On a bridge, the one bridge fee, capped the same way, in basis points of the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WITHDRAWAL_NETWORK: Estimated network fee for a withdrawal. The actual fee is charged at withdrawal time and reported on the withdrawal.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE: The deposit arrived and is safe, but processing capacity is temporarily unavailable. Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; no action is needed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM: The deposit is above max_deposit_amount, or above the largest order the route's market accepts. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_ALREADY_USED: The address already accepted its one eligible deposit; this deposit is returned to return_address and never executes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT: The QuickSwap could not be issued a deposit address and never gets one: it is EXPIRED without deposit_instructions, and nothing can be deposited to it. Create a new QuickSwap with a new idempotency key, and report the swap_id to Polyester broker support.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_NOT_ISSUED: The address had not been issued when this deposit was observed; it never executes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED: The address was retired when this deposit was observed. The deposit is MANUAL_RECOVERY: it never executes, is not returned automatically, and is potentially unrecoverable.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM: The deposit is below the published min_deposit_amount, or its credit after the deposit network fee is below the smallest order the route's market accepts. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason. A deposit that cannot be returned on the network it was received on is held (HELD with this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTION_DEADLINE_REACHED: The execution deadline passed before all input executed; untraded funds are refunded or returned. Shown while EXECUTING once the deadline ended trading, and on the payout statuses that follow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED: The funding window ended without an eligible deposit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM: On a two-leg route, intermediate funds were below the smallest order the second leg's market accepts, so they could not be converted to the destination asset; they are refunded to refund_address. Shown on the payout statuses that follow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LATE_DEPOSIT: The deposit was first seen after funding_expires_at.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_CLOSED: A market on the route was halted, restricted or delisted when the deposit was credited and did not reopen within a bounded wait after the deposit was credited, the same for market and TWAP execution. Nothing was traded: the deposit is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OUTCOME_RECONCILING: A processing step is being confirmed. Processing resumes automatically; no action is needed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROTECTION_NOT_MET: Execution could not meet the protection; untraded funds are refunded or returned. When no protected order could be placed for the deposit, nothing is traded: the deposit is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM: Refund not possible: an amount left to refund or return was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network, so no withdrawal was made for it. Its withdrawal is NOT_SENT with the amount in unsent_amount. Other withdrawals are unaffected.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED: Polyester's deposit screening blocked the deposit. It is held for compliance review (HELD); it is never executed or returned automatically. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id. If Zipper's compliance team later transfers the funds out to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's, the QuickSwap ends CLOSED with this reason; the funds were not returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED: The deposit's risk screen failed with a return verdict; the deposit is not accepted and is returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WITHDRAWAL_FAILED: A withdrawal cannot be completed and is held for review. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WRONG_ASSET: The deposit is not the quoted source asset or network. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address on the network and in the asset it was received in, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason. A deposit that cannot be returned there, such as one received on a network where return_address is not valid, is held (HELD with this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALLOCATING: The quote is fixed and the deposit address is being allocated. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE, allocation continues automatically until an address frees up; the wait has no fixed bound.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AWAITING_DEPOSIT: Quote and deposit address allocated; waiting for the first eligible deposit before funding_expires_at.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLOSED: Terminal: the deposit was blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED), and Zipper's compliance team transferred the funds out on the deposit's network to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's. Nothing was returned to return_address or refunded. Its one withdrawal is that COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, FINALIZED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT) and at least one is a DESTINATION withdrawal. A DESTINATION withdrawal is never NOT_SENT.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMING: Waiting for source confirmations and deposit validation before credit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREDITED: The deposit is credited; execution is starting.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTING: The credited deposit is being traded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRED: Terminal: the funding window ended without an eligible deposit (FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED), or the QuickSwap never got a deposit address (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HELD: Funds are held for review. Not terminal: review resumes the QuickSwap or returns the funds, or, for SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED, the QuickSwap can end CLOSED. reason says why when a specific reason applies, else it is REASON_UNSPECIFIED. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYING_OUT: Execution finished with destination output; withdrawals, including any partial refund or return, are in progress.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PREPARING_DEPOSIT: The deposit is being prepared for credit. Retries keep this status.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUNDED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final, none is DESTINATION, and at least one is REFUND (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUNDING: A two-leg route produced no destination output; the intermediate asset is being refunded to refund_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURNED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final and all are RETURN (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURNING: Nothing was traded or the deposit was not accepted; the source funds are being returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY: An eligible deposit arrived and is safe; waiting for processing capacity. Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; the wait has no fixed bound.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION_AMOUNT: amount is the destination amount the end user wants to receive after fees, in destination token units. The quote reports the deposit amount needed at the quoted price. The delivered amount still follows the actual deposit and execution, bounded below by the protection.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_AMOUNT: amount is the source amount the end user intends to deposit, in source token units.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER: A deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) that Zipper's compliance team transferred out on the network it was received on, to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's. Not a return or a refund: Polyester records neither the recipient nor the amount, so address, memo, amount and network_fee are unset; tx_hash is the transfer, and flow_id the deposit's flow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION: Swap output to destination_address on the destination network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND: Untraded intermediate asset of a two-leg route, including a partial refund, to refund_address on the refund route's network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN: Source funds that were not accepted or not traded, to return_address on the network and in the asset they were received in: the source network, or for a wrong asset the network it was sent on.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Definitively failed. The QuickSwap is HELD (WITHDRAWAL_FAILED); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_SENT: Final: no transaction was or will be made for this withdrawal, because its amount was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network (REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM); unsent_amount is that amount.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUEUED: Approved and waiting to be submitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Submitted to the recipient's network; not yet final.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

post.description: Create or return the QuickSwap and deposit address for an idempotency key.

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT (malformed request, AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE, DECIMALS_MISMATCH, DESTINATION_ADDRESS_INVALID, RETURN_ADDRESS_INVALID, REFUND_ADDRESS_INVALID, SOURCE_WALLET_INVALID or FEES_INVALID) or FAILED_PRECONDITION (ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED, PROTECTION_UNACHIEVABLE, REFUND_ADDRESS_REQUIRED or AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN); nothing is bound to the key.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid broker API key.

403.description: BROKER_DISABLED: the broker is disabled; quotes and creates are refused, reads and QuickSwaps already created continue.

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was already used with a different request; swapId is the original QuickSwap. ADDRESS_CONFLICT: the QuickSwap (swapId) never gets a deposit address; create a new one with a new idempotency key.

413.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT: the request body is too large.

429.description: BROKER_LIMIT: the broker holds its maximum of unfunded QuickSwaps or created its maximum in the last hour (a funded or expired QuickSwap frees a slot), or the API key exceeded its request rate (retry after the Retry-After header's seconds); nothing is bound to the key.

500.description: INTERNAL: an internal error; the outcome is unknown, retry the same request.

503.description: ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE: the QuickSwap (swapId) is kept and gets its address automatically; follow it with GetQuickSwap or the same request. QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE: outcome unknown; retry the same request.

504.description: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: outcome unknown; retry the same request.
